definitions.explanation: The act of depositing money into a bank account or entrusting luggage or belongings to a storage service. Common in banking and travel contexts.

examples.japanese: ATM⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{預|あず}け{入|い}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I make a deposit at the ATM.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手荷物|てにもつ}→手荷物：09928_tenimotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{預|あず}け{入|い}れ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦カウンター→カウンター：10816_kauntaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}います→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Luggage check-in is done at the counter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{定期|ていき}{預金|よきん}→定期預金：22251_teikiyokin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{預|あず}け{入|い}れ⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧な⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to the bank with the documents needed for the fixed deposit procedure.

notes:
USAGE: {預|あず}け{入|い}れ is the noun form of {預|あず}け{入|い}れる (to deposit). It is used in both financial contexts (depositing money) and travel contexts (checking in luggage).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {預|あず}け{入|い}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make a deposit
- ⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{預|あず}け{入|い}れ: cash deposit
- ⟦{手荷物|てにもつ}→手荷物：09928_tenimotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{預|あず}け{入|い}れ: luggage check-in
- {預|あず}け{入|い}れ⟦{限度額|げんどがく}→限度額：20870_gendogaku⟧: deposit limit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {預|あず}け{入|い}れ: depositing (putting money/items in)
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}し→引き出し：01498_hikidashi⟧: withdrawal (taking money/items out)
